limitations: orchestrator.modal_assets.BASE_IMAGE is outside the packet scope, so the concrete pinned image identity and its actual /usr/bin/python3 interpreter path cannot be independently verified here; the interpreter correction's correctness rests on the brief's claimed registry-manifest/config SHA256 verification and is corroborated by codebase-wide use of /usr/bin/python3 for all other services.
Test suites (focused, full-pytest, full-orchestration) are reported as passing in TEST_SUMMARY.md/PRIOR_COVERAGE but were not re-executed in this read-only review (no execution authority).

The recovery controller test (tests/test_modal_direct_recovery.py linked fixture) monkeypatches recovery.selection, so real provenance validation is exercised only via the separate scratch tests (preserved/recovery_installation); the end-to-end integration of real selection + real controller flow is not jointly executed.

PRIVATE_COPY_REHEARSAL explicitly labels the child completion receipt and root mapping as synthetic; no live provider call or live DB open occurred, so actual corrected launch remains an unverified post-review gate.
Unchanged prior approval is identified only by source/report hash (PRIOR_COVERAGE report_sha256), not re-inspected originals.
rationale: Independent inspection confirms the change is correctly scoped and preserves the required safety invariants. (1) Interpreter correction: modal_download_provider.py:99 changes only the launch arg from /opt/conda/bin/python to /usr/bin/python3; all surrounding Sandbox.create confinement (gpu=None, cpu=(1,1), memory=(2048,2048), timeout, empty secrets/env, no OIDC, empty cidr allowlist, DOMAINS, read-only package volume) is unchanged, and the provider test asserts the exact new argv and all confinement kwargs. This is consistent with system-wide /usr/bin/python3 usage (promotion hooks, storage ExecStart, nested probe). (2) Cost/provenance preservation: parent() performs strictly read-only SELECTs and raises DIRECT_RECOVERY_ORIGINAL_LEDGER_CHANGED unless the parent row is still UNCERTAIN with its original binding/run/receipt/reserved_micro_usd and an ACTIVE/COMPLETE owner run matching owner(binding). selection() re-verifies installed releases, config path, unit set, held units, immutable binding hash==PARENT, original FAILED/sandbox handle, and an exact pre-Python terminal proof (exit 2, empty stdout, exact ERROR stderr, zero data-volume files/bytes, zero provider mutations). (3) Both reservations count: modal_direct_budget.reserve sums old_assets+compute (parent included) against item4 SMOKE/TOTAL caps and provider headroom; modal_budget asset_total/total include the UNCERTAIN parent row; resolved_failure_ids only exempts the parent id from the UNCERTAIN *blocking* check, never from cost sums. (4) Admission gating: only a READY recovery child whose receipt is VERIFIED with binding_sha256==child id, canonical digest==child id, and recovery_of==PARENT closes the parent's downstream admission; pending/failed/other uncertain rows still block (id!=predecessor_id); duplicate verified children raise DIRECT_RECOVERY_DUPLICATE_CHILD. (5) No scientific allowance: administrative M4 owner cannot admit science (autonomy_accounting.py:40). (6) Fresh state/new disabled units with same owner and original retention deadline; preflight runs before any provisioning write (direct_storage_service.install, host_check); live_empty re-checks provider terminal+empty volume before reserving. (7) resolved_failure_ids short-circuits with no filesystem access when no recovery child exists, so the common accounting path is unregressed. No unresolved finding in any fixed category was identified; remaining items are scope limitations recorded above, not defects. Per the brief, analysis_entrypoint is bound to orchestrator.analysis_driver.
